preconditions.description: The number of rows n must be between 1 and 5.
The number of columns m must be between 1 and 20.
The length of the row segments list a must equal the number of rows n.
The length of the column segments list b must equal the number of columns m.

postconditions.expression: all(len(row) == m for row in output)
postconditions.description: Each row in the output must have exactly m characters.
Each character in the output must be either '.' or '*'.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(1 for c in row if c == '*') == a[i] for i, row in enumerate(output))
postconditions.description: The number of contiguous black segments in each row must match the corresponding value in a.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(1 for row in output if row[j] == '*') == b[j] for j in range(m))
postconditions.description: The number of contiguous black segments in each column must match the corresponding value in b.
